escena: SCENE (IT lead's desk after everyone left, Santiago, early evening, NOBODY IN FRAME): verify it — there is not a single person, hand or body anywhere in the picture. What remains is the trace of a decision waiting: the chair pushed back and turned away from the desk, a closed laptop resting on its side, a cold mug. The only strong light is a hard low beam from a window at the left, raking across the empty desk, with thin haze drifting in it so the beam is visible. A wide desktop monitor stands at the right, still awake, its glowing cool blue display the second light source in the room: it shows a plain work chart of narrow rows and four short columns, and the last column is conspicuously empty — every row in it blank. The empty column is the calmest, most isolated thing on the desk, separated from everything else. 105mm lens at f/2, focus on that empty column. The office behind falls into deep shadow. Everything except the small sculpture is completely unbranded, with no readable text anywhere: any lettering on screen or paper is small, angled or out of focus.

lecho.objeto: the near edge of the dark walnut desk in shadow against the lens

texto.muro: a plain painted concrete wall in deep warm shadow, its texture visible

seleccion.objeto: the empty last column of the work chart on the monitor
seleccion.campo: the monitor's own dark interface panel in shadow
